marquee_mode.label: Text scroll
marquee_mode.description: Choose how overflowing one-line text behaves.
marquee_mode.always_desc: Keep long text scrolling when it overflows (recommended).
marquee_mode.hover_only_desc: Scroll only while the pointer is over the text.
marquee_mode.off_desc: Disable scrolling; use ellipsis for overflow.

font_scale.label: Overall font size
font_scale.description: Changes the root font size (%); rem-based typography and spacing follow. Auxiliary labels use rem so they scale too.
font_scale.s100_desc: Default browser size. Use this when developing on a desktop browser.
font_scale.s150_desc: Larger text in CEF while keeping more information on screen.
font_scale.s200_desc: Tuned for the FiveM CEF default appearance. Recommended.
font_scale.s250_desc: Larger UI text when you still need more size than 200%.
font_scale.s300_desc: Maximum scale; expect more wrapping on small layouts.
